playstyle.identity: Vladimir is a resourceless drain mage who scales into a late-game monster. His pool makes him untargetable and he sustains through fights with healing.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive converts HP to AP and AP to HP. Q drains (empowered Q heals more). W pools, becoming untargetable (costs HP). E charges and releases AoE damage (costs HP). R marks enemies to take more damage and heals Vlad after. Sustain through laning, scale to teamfight monster.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Vladimir spikes with levels and at CDR breakpoints. Hextech Rocketbelt adds engage. He's a late-game hyperscaling mage.

passive.name: Crimson Pact
passive.summary: Bonus health gives AP; AP gives bonus health.
passive.details: Vladimir gains ability power based on his bonus health and bonus health based on his ability power.

abilities.name: Transfusion
abilities.summary: Drain an enemy for damage and healing. Empowered Q heals more.
abilities.details: Vladimir drains health from an enemy. After casting it several times, his next Q is empowered to deal more damage and heal significantly more.

abilities.name: Sanguine Pool
abilities.summary: Sink into a pool of blood, becoming untargetable and slowing enemies.
abilities.details: Vladimir sinks into a pool of blood, becoming untargetable. He slows enemies above him and drains their health. Costs health to use.

abilities.name: Tides of Blood
abilities.summary: Charge and release a burst of blood that damages enemies.
abilities.details: Vladimir charges up blood, then releases it in a nova around him dealing damage. Costs health and deals more damage when charged longer.

abilities.name: Hemoplague
abilities.summary: Infect enemies to take more damage; heals Vladimir when it detonates.
abilities.details: Vladimir infects enemies in an area, causing them to take increased damage. After a delay, the infection detonates, dealing damage and healing Vladimir for each champion hit.
